deadline.value: Complete the application by February 1 for Fall admission; the domestic deadline is July 1.
deadline.quote: An interested international student should try to complete the application by February 1 for Fall admission in order to receive full attention.

gre_general.value: The GRE General and Subject tests are recommended, not required.
gre_general.quote: The GRE exam and GRE subject exam are recommended, but not required

gre_subject.value: The GRE Physics subject test is recommended, not required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE exam and GRE subject exam are recommended, but not required

supervisor.value: Admission does not depend on a faculty supervisor; the graduate coordinator advises until a research advisor is found within a year.
supervisor.quote: Before that, the graduate coordinator is the academic advisor of the student.

funding.value: The department admits a student only if it can offer a teaching or research assistantship.
funding.quote: The department has the policy to only admit a student if we can offer that student an assistantship (teaching or research assistant).

also.quote: Continuing financial support is contingent upon the student maintaining at least a 3.00 GPA and making satisfactory progress towards the degree

entry_route.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

notes: The Applied Physics PhD is applied for through the Bagley College of Engineering (Engineering major, Applied Physics concentration); its rules were not checked.
